say:6:1010505001:0.text: Strange... Take a look at those two guards. Don't their helmets look a little different from the others we've seen?
say:6:1010505001:0.source_cn: 奇怪……那两个守卫的盔甲，是不是和之前见到的都不太一样？

say:7:1010505002:0.text: They don't appear to be Lord Franz's henchmen or even the mercenaries he hired.
say:7:1010505002:0.source_cn: 他们不像是弗朗茨的直属卫兵，也不像是那些雇佣兵。

say:9:1010505004:0.text: There's no mistaking it... I recognize the insignia.
say:9:1010505004:0.source_cn: 错不了……我认识他们胸前的标志。

say:10:1010505005:0.text: That's the mark of the <style="highlight">Adamant Syndicate</style>!

say:13:1010505006:0.text: Since the hidden passage is in that cave, it must mean that they're helping Lord Franz guard it, right?
say:13:1010505006:0.source_cn: 既然洞窟里有密道，难道他们在帮弗朗茨看守密道？

say:14:1010505007:0.text: Guess it doesn't matter. We could just beat the answers out of them.
say:14:1010505007:0.source_cn: 管他呢，打一顿就该招了。

say:15:1010505008:0.text: Wait! Did you forget that we're trying to sneak in? A big fight will only draw unnecessary attention!
say:15:1010505008:0.source_cn: 等等！别忘了我们要潜入宅邸，这会儿打起来，不就暴露行踪了吗？

say:16:1010505009:0.text: Everyone, stay calm! We gotta play it safe.
say:16:1010505009:0.source_cn: 都给我冷静点！要谨慎行事。

say:17:1010505010:0.text: I was only joking, Lorsan. No need to get so riled up.
say:17:1010505010:0.source_cn: 我只是开个玩笑，用不着你提醒。

say:18:1010505011:0.text: I know we can't use force to sneak in, which means we have to find a way to distract them.
say:18:1010505011:0.source_cn: 既然不能采取强硬手段，只能想个办法把他们引开了。

say:19:1010505012:0.text: Sounds like a job for me! I'll do my best to draw their attention while the rest of you slip into the secret passage.
say:19:1010505012:0.source_cn: 让我去吧！我来想办法引开守卫，你们找机会溜进密道。

say:20:1010505013:0.text: Hold it right there, kid. Leave the dangerous stuff to me.
say:20:1010505013:0.source_cn: 你一个小孩子，老老实实待着吧。这种危险的事情还是交给我。

say:21:1010505014:0.text: Did you forget, Mr. Valen? I'm the only one here with a gold invitation! They wouldn't dare to do anything to me.
say:21:1010505014:0.source_cn: 维伦先生，我手上有黄金邀请函，他们不敢拿我怎么样，没人...

say:22:1010505015:0.text: Besides, I agreed to come along in order to repay you for all you've done.
say:22:1010505015:0.source_cn: 何况，正因为我想报答你们，所以才决定跟来，请你们理解。
say:22:1010505015:0.male: Besides, I agreed to come along in order to repay you for all you've done.
say:22:1010505015:0.female: Besides, I agreed to come along in order to repay you for all you've done.

choice_prompt:23:1010505015.text: Besides, I agreed to come along in order to repay you for all you've done.
choice_prompt:23:1010505015.source_cn: 何况，正因为我想报答你们，所以才决定跟来，请你们理解。
choice_prompt:23:1010505015.male: Besides, I agreed to come along in order to repay you for all you've done.
choice_prompt:23:1010505015.female: Besides, I agreed to come along in order to repay you for all you've done.

say:24:1010505016:0.text: So don't worry. I'm not only lucky in business. Lady Luck always smiles at me when I need it the most.
say:24:1010505016:0.source_cn: 放心吧，我不仅财运好，其他方面的运气也很好。
say:24:1010505016:0.male: So don't worry. I'm not only lucky in business. Lady Luck always smiles at me when I need it the most.
say:24:1010505016:0.female: So don't worry. I'm not only lucky in business. Lady Luck always smiles at me when I need it the most.

narration:27:1010505018:0.text: After taking a few deep breaths, Rowan boldly walks up to the two guards near the cave.
narration:27:1010505018:0.source_cn: 罗万做了几个深呼吸，独自走向了堵在洞窟前方的那两个人

say:28:1010505019:0.text:
Greetings! I seem to be lost.
Could you please point me toward Lord Franz's manor? I've come to attend the <style="highlight">Golden Banquet</style>.
say:28:1010505019:0.source_cn: 你们好！我想问个路。\n请问弗朗茨的宅邸在哪个方向？我...

say:29:1010505020:0.text: I have the invitation right here.
say:29:1010505020:0.source_cn: 请看，这是我收到的邀请函。

say:31:1010505021:0.text: Beat it, kid! And get that paper out of my face!
say:31:1010505021:0.source_cn: 别给我看那种废纸，快滚！

say:32:1010505022:0.text: Wait! Could it be that you two are lost as well?

say:33:1010505023:0.text: Or are you unaware of the grand feast that Lord Franz is hosting at his manor tonight?
say:33:1010505023:0.source_cn: 你们知不知道弗朗茨的宅邸今晚会举办宴会？

say:34:1010505024:0.text: You ask too many questions, kid! Now, get lost!
say:34:1010505024:0.source_cn: 小鬼，你问题真多！我没有任何义务回答你！

say:35:1010505025:0.text: Oh, I meant no offense... I just wanted to ask for directions...
say:35:1010505025:0.source_cn: 别别别……别生气啊。我只想问问路……

say:36:1010505026:0.text: I told you to get lost, squirt! If you're not gone in the next three seconds, I'm gonna beat some sense into you!
say:36:1010505026:0.source_cn: 我已经说了！快——滚——！再不滚，可别怪我不客气！

say:38:1010505017:0.text: Hey, you're looking at the man who will take over the Mithril Consortium someday. You can trust me with something simple like this.
say:38:1010505017:0.source_cn: 我好歹是秘银商会的少东家，这点小事，你尽管相信我吧。
say:38:1010505017:0.male: Hey, you're looking at the man who will take over the Mithril Consortium someday. You can trust me with something simple like this.
say:38:1010505017:0.female: Hey, you're looking at the man who will take over the Mithril Consortium someday. You can trust me with something simple like this.

narration:39:1010521:0.text: You encounter many more guards in the secret passage leading to Goldsmith Manor.
narration:39:1010521:0.source_cn: 通往酿金庄园的密道中，也有不少守卫。
